The Program Associate must be comfortable speaking publicly, presenting program information, responding to questions, and representing the clientprofessionally before a variety of audiences.

Job Description
  • Responsible for the day-to-day operational support, maintenance, remediation, and infrastructure management of Intermediate Distribution Frames (IDFs) and Main Distribution Frames (MDFs).
